summary: RETEST after auth fix (recruit_me -> get_current_user_portal). Full frontend Phase 2 My Day/My Time flows PASS on mobile 390x844. Backend regression 6/6 pytest PASS. Staff Portal now loads correctly at /staff-portal with data-testids intact for all documented flows.

minor.issue: recompute_day blends employee_entry with same-day clock events oddly: when both exist, top-level start_time/finish_time/break_minutes come from clock events (e.g. 17:46/17:47/0) but source is still 'employee_time_entry' and raw_worked_hours=0.0 while employee_entry.worked_hours correctly shows 8.0. The timesheet POST does not clear same-day clock events, so the displayed record misrepresents the entry. Suggest either (a) purging staff_clock_events for the date on timesheet POST, or (b) preferring employee_entry when both present (populate top-level start/finish/break/raw_worked_hours from employee_entry). Also caused pytest pollution when a prior clock UI action leaves events behind (test file has no autouse cleanup for staff_clock_events).

Test file lacks a fixture that cleans staff_clock_events / staff_leave_requests (sick, today) / attendance_daily (today) for SPDEMO_emp_staff before/after each test. Tests are order-dependent and fail on any subsequent run because test_report_absence_sick_marks_today leaves an approved sick leave + an attendance_daily row that survives across pytest sessions.

action_items: Optional: fix recompute_day blending of clock_events with employee_entry so the response is internally consistent (top-level raw_worked_hours should reflect the winning source).

Optional: add an autouse pytest fixture to test_staff_portal_myday_jan2026.py that wipes staff_clock_events + today's attendance_daily + today's sick leave for SPDEMO_emp_staff, so the suite is repeatable.
critical_code_review_comments: recompute_day mixes clock events and employee_entry rather than choosing one canonical source per day; leads to a record where source=employee_time_entry but start/finish come from clock and raw_worked_hours=0.

The regression tests do not clean their own state (staff_clock_events, today's leave, today's attendance_daily) — running the suite twice in a row will fail on day/timesheet math because the first sick-absence test poisons subsequent recomputes.

rca_of_the_issue:
Auth RCA (fixed): recruit_me depended on get_current_user which forbids portal-only users; staff JWTs got 403. Fix at staff_onboarding_wizard.py:1545 switched to get_current_user_portal. Verified via curl (200) and full Playwright pass.

New minor RCA (backend suite): test_day_timesheet_hours_math fails on re-runs because (a) an approved sick leave for today from test_report_absence_sick_marks_today survives across sessions, and (b) UI clock punches (staff_clock_events) from Playwright poison recompute_day. Cleanup snippet:

await db.staff_clock_events.delete_many({'staff_id':'SPDEMO_emp_staff'})
await db.staff_leave_requests.delete_many({'staff_id':'SPDEMO_emp_staff','leave_type':'sick','start_date':<today>})
await db.attendance_daily.delete_many({'organization_id':'iso-demo-org','staff_id':'SPDEMO_emp_staff','date':<today>})

After cleanup the suite is 6/6 green.
